reasoning: Both attempts widen Title the same way and pass every check, and neither adds a long-title preset. A shares the selection between the control and tile clicks with a source and an effect, so the picker stays in place. B tears the picker down and rebuilds it through `indexes` on each control change, leaves a debug print in, and depends on newer `const` syntax and `@game` string-require aliases. B is better typed, but A is the simpler, sturdier change that a developer is more likely to merge.
